lastResponse.text: That’s still a great start, and you’re helping her move this forward. When you call, say: “I’m helping my sister in Washington County. She has two kids, a toddler and a kindergartener, and she just started a job and needs child care quickly.” Then ask for urgent child care subsidy options and any short-term care while she waits. If you can, gather her ZIP code, work hours, and income estimate next so two one one can screen her faster.
